modalLead: Dropdowns follow the theme, the install count waits a day, and a news item opened far down the list shows at once.

items.text: Dropdowns follow the theme. They were filled with the page's darkest colour; now they look like the text fields beside them, and their lists take the theme's surface.
Opening a news item from far down the list shows it. On a phone the news window now scrolls to the top when an article opens.
The Version panel links the changelog on nextdash.cc.
The install count waits a day. A server only counts once it has run for a day, and sends at most one request a day.
